entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana with VeloFit. How can I help you today?
I need to return a helmet.
I can certainly look into that for you. Could I get your name and order number, please?
Thank you, Mark. One moment... I see the Velo-Guard helmet here. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
The color is just not right. It's been in the closet since it arrived. The box is still unopened.
I understand completely. Getting the right color is important, not just for looks but for visibility and your overall safety. Let me just confirm the return eligibility for you.

Okay, I see here the delivery was 77 days ago. Since the helmet is a standard item, our policy allows for returns within 90 days. You're well within that window, so I can process this for you right now.
Fine. I suppose that's how it should be.

I've just sent a prepaid return label to the email we have on file. And Mark, I do see you're a VIP member with us. I want to apologize that the color wasn't a perfect match. As a thank you for your loyalty, I've added a $25 credit to your account for a future order.
The credit is available for you to use immediately. Once we receive the helmet, you'll see the full refund processed within 3-5 business days. Was there anything else I could assist with?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, Mark. Have a good rest of your day.
